column3: “Sent them in the hand of” is rendered “delivered them into the power of.”
“Abode of your righteousness” is rendered “your righteous estate.”
“The searching of their ancestors” is rendered “the things searched out by their fathers.”
“From their heart” is rendered “from their minds.”
“Plucked off” is rendered “cut down”; NASB adds “other.”
“It snaps” is rendered “is fragile”; the meaning of the Hebrew word is uncertain. “House of a spider” is rendered “a spider's web.”
“Sees” is rendered “grasps”; NASB follows another reading, and the meaning is uncertain.
“The joy of its way” is rendered “the joy of His way”; the meaning is uncertain.
“Takes hold on the hand” is rendered “support.”
